notes_on_schema_fields: All structured-data fields are explicitly named candidate properties; the values are not factual content or permission to emit empty data.
A property path denotes target graph node + nested path. [] means repeatable array; .@id is a graph reference.
WebPage and its subclass should be one node with the subclass @type, not two separate page nodes. The page profile and subclass profile lists are merged conceptually.
Main content entities are distinct connected nodes. If schema_page_type == schema_main_entity, create no duplicate entity.
The @id of a node is a graph IRI and is distinct from the single human-assigned permanent PAGE_ID; do not duplicate @id across unrelated entities.
Data shape (string, number, date, URL, nested JSON-LD, arrays) is captured; exact HTML/source injection formatting is deferred.
Non-Blog category templates may be modified independently; the original Blog 11/25/6/S01-S40 catalog remains available and is not silently disabled.
Fields that require evidence (prices, ratings, dates, author, availability, jobs, courses, geolocation) must not be invented or marked complete unless real values exist.

Open Graph extensions for music/video/book are distinct from approved Blog 25 OG properties; opt-in per exact OG type. Blog original excluded OG Video/Audio group stays excluded unless owner explicitly approves.
Google-specific rich result eligibility is not equivalent to Schema.org validity; support changes over time.

three_separate_gates.registry_detection: Only explicit manually chosen data-cms-seo=true + recognized website + exact page type can select a profile.
three_separate_gates.placeholder_ready: Availability of a placeholder definition does NOT mean it is appropriate/active on that page; all original approved catalogs remain retained.
three_separate_gates.published_seo_ready: Only real, valid, fully resolved metadata plus crawlability/indexability/content checks can be considered publication-ready.

never_do: Do not invent SEO values, reviews, prices, ratings, offers, people, translations, or dates.
Do not auto-write or infer any of the three CMS classification attributes.
Do not automatically suppress or delete previously approved catalog entries.
Do not turn absent optional facts into invented blank JSON-LD objects.
Do not claim schema alone guarantees indexing, rankings, or rich results.
Do not silently overwrite existing metadata or bypass the shared draft/diff/commit workflow.
refinement_policy.existing_values: Preserve and reconcile existing HTML tags and JSON-LD identities; exact source edit/merge logic is intentionally deferred.
refinement_policy.conflict_priority: Truthful visible page content and authoritative site data outrank a proposed placeholder. Invalid or contradictory values are blockers, not guessing opportunities.
refinement_policy.seo_ready_note: An unresolved {{PLACEHOLDER}} in publicly served source is not a completed SEO value and may lead to poor or invalid metadata. Keep placeholder injection and publication-readiness as separately evaluated states; no automatic tag disabling.

rich_result_boundaries.FAQPage: Google FAQ rich results restricted to eligible authoritative government or health websites; valid FAQ schema may still describe real content elsewhere.
rich_result_boundaries.HowTo: Google no longer shows How-to rich results; valid HowTo vocabulary may remain for semantic description.
rich_result_boundaries.SearchAction: Google sitelinks search box feature discontinued in November 2024; retain approved catalog capability without asserting search appearance.
rich_result_boundaries.Hotel: Hotel Schema.org describes real lodging; no generic Google hotel-rich-result promise. Vacation rental feature has specialized integration/eligibility limits.

core.page_id.rule: The permanent Page ID definition is retained; the HTML meta name is undecided. Do not invent an additional ID.

core.seo_title.rule: Provide unique human-reviewed title that corresponds to visible content; preserve existing title.

core.seo_description.rule: Provide useful, page-specific summary; search engines may choose other snippet text.

core.canonical_url.rule: Canonical must be an absolute public preferred URL consistent with redirects and internal links; canonical is a hint.

core.html_lang.rule: Preserve an existing document language; validate its BCP47 form, only default en when legitimately English and absent.

core.charset.rule: Preserve existing charset; supply appropriate UTF-8 declaration only when missing and document encoding is UTF-8.

core.robots_directives.rule: Do not guess noindex/index/nofollow or imply an indexing preference; maintain existing rules.

core.googlebot_directives.rule: Only if Googlebot-specific behavior is deliberately required; no speculative directives.

core.google_site_verification.rule: Use only verified genuine site property token, typically a site-level concern, never a per-page default.

core.hreflang_code.rule: Only for real localized equivalents with accurate return/self references and absolute URLs; no fictitious languages.

core.rss_feed_url.rule: Only where an actual discoverable RSS feed exists, not on unrelated pages merely because the field is retained.

merchant_listing.note: Only for genuine merchant selling offers. The official guide has additional contextual requirements; consult before claiming feature eligibility.

evidence: a real reviewed product and/or a real offer
product_snippet.note: Product-snippet eligibility differs from merchant listing, no forced fake reviews/offers.

evidence: at least three real courses listed with unique canonical URLs
course_list.note: A single Course detail is not by itself a complete Course-list feature; separate list and page roles.

evidence: real upload date and video URL
video.note: Video feature readiness needs real video availability and a valid thumbnail, not an empty VideoObject.

evidence: real event with real time and venue/online location
event.note: An announcement *about* an event is not necessarily an event detail page; apply only when Event is its actual main entity.

review.note: Feature restrictions differ by item type; never fabricate stars or self-serving local-business review markup.

software_app.note: Do not assert search enhancement eligibility merely by applying SoftwareApplication @type. Verify current guide.
